Package fr.campus.dungeoncrawler.game

Class Game

java.lang.Object
fr.campus.dungeoncrawler.game.Game
public class Game extends Object
Controls the main flow of the Dungeon Crawler game.

This class is responsible for:

  • creating and managing the character,
  • moving the character across the board,
  • managing interactions with cells,
  • managing turn-based fights,
  • checking the end-of-game conditions.

  • Constructor Details

    • Game

      public Game(Menu menu, Board board, Dice movementDice, Dice combatDice)
      Creates a new game with all its required dependencies.
      Parameters:
      menu - the menu used to display information and read the player's choices
      board - the board containing all game cells
      movementDice - the dice used to move forward or backward on the board
      combatDice - the twenty-sided dice used to determine critical attacks

  • Method Details

    • start

      public void start()
      Starts the application.

      This method displays the main menus, creates the character, allows the player to change its name and starts the board game.

    • startGame

      public void startGame()
      Starts the board game and continues until the character reaches the final cell or loses all health points.

      During each turn, the character rolls the movement dice, moves to a new cell and interacts with the content of that cell.

    • reStartGame

      public void reStartGame()
      Restarts the game from the beginning.

      The character position is reset to zero before displaying the main menu and creating a new character.

    • changePosition

      public void changePosition(int diceResult) throws OutOfBoardException
      Moves the character forward according to the movement dice result.
      Parameters:
      diceResult - the number of cells to move forward
      Throws:
      OutOfBoardException - if the new position exceeds cell 64

    • changeReversePosition

      public void changeReversePosition(int diceResult)
      Moves the character backward after running away from a fight.

      The position cannot be lower than zero. Position zero means that the character is located before the first board cell.

      Parameters:
      diceResult - the number of cells to move backward
